title: Promote independent adopter claims from bounded deployment prose
rawUserRequest: Continue the merged-main trigger investigation. When a problem is found, keep iterating through a new governed Work Item and complete the full local, CI, PR, merge, and closure lifecycle until the result has no remaining in-scope defect.

executionDecision.reason: The merged-main report identifies one exact missing proof: Atos is independently configured and substantively extracted, but the named-adopter matcher does not recognize the bounded 'Atos Group ... to deploy' construction. A deterministic fixture can reproduce the defect and guide a minimal fix.

acceptance: A regression fixture representing the Atos independent disclosure with 'Atos Group becomes ... to deploy Microsoft 365 Copilot' fails before the implementation change because the validated candidate has no named adopter.

The minimal bounded extraction change promotes the same validated candidate to IndustryDiffusion with named adopter 'Atos Group' and IndependentCustomerDisclosure, without changing its source URI or date.
Existing PwC deployed, Atos rolling-out, supplier-attribution, title-only, and incomplete-gate behavior remains unchanged and covered by tests.

The merged-main dry-run reports Microsoft with two independent diffusion sources and no independent_diffusion_sources gap; if another gate remains open, the report must state that gate and emit no Ranking unless the existing complete contract is satisfied.
Rust, Python, Shell/governance checks, hosted CI, PR merge, and Work Item closure complete with clean local and remote state.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented; prefer a private bounded helper when no public API is needed.
Keep source-role classification and evidence promotion deterministic in Rust.
Use only explicitly configured bounded URLs; do not infer or add sources in this WI.
Preserve SupplierAttribution, IndependentCustomerDisclosure, RegulatoryOrFiling, and DiscoveryOnly as distinct evidence states.
Do not weaken fail-closed gates or infer confirmation from source availability alone.
Use Python and Shell only for bounded orchestration, fixtures, and governance verification; keep research semantics in Rust.

intent.problem: The merged-main trigger produced 46 validated facts and 26 structural evidence records. Microsoft had all four evidence families, four result periods, and three supplier-attribution sources, but the report counted only one independent diffusion source even though both PwC and Atos independent documents were configured and reachable. The Atos document was retained as structural evidence, but the named-adopter extractor missed the 'Atos Group becomes ... to deploy' construction, so the independent diffusion gate correctly remained closed.
constraints: Fix only the bounded named-adopter extraction seam and its tests/documentation.
Do not change the independent-source threshold, provenance mapping, four-family gate, counter-evidence review, SEC behavior, or Ranking policy.
Use a deterministic fixture mirroring the observed Atos title/body shape; no live-network dependence in unit tests.
Keep the extractor bounded to explicit adoption/deployment verbs and sentence boundaries so generic prose cannot become evidence.
intent.rationale: The live result isolates a parser boundary defect: the source is available and independently typed, and the domain gate already refuses to count it without a named adopter. Extending the existing matcher with a bounded infinitive-deployment construction is the smallest change that can make the source count honestly reflect the evidence already present.
